lines.t: In this Roblox game, your photos can start a riot.

lines.t: You're a journalist hired by Big Media. Your job is to spread panic, so everyone keeps watching the news.

lines.t: It's based on a 2016 browser game by Nicky Case. Will you wreck the park, or try to bring hope? There are 12 endings.
